notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata fetching collects title and description, but not favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but there is no separate note field.
REF-BM-06: Saving performs no duplicate-URL detection or convergence to the existing item.
REF-BM-07: Cards show title, description, and tags, but use a generated domain initial rather than the collected favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain text field without autocomplete.
REF-BM-11: Displayed tags are not selectable filters.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, domain, and tags, but not a separate note or the full URL path.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is not parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is not implemented.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state or action exists; READ LATER is only seed tag text.
REF-BM-18: There is no separate unread view.
REF-BM-19: There is no mark-as-read action.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action UI.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-23: There is no distinct markdown note field or rendered bookmark view.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving and default-list exclusion are not implemented.
REF-BM-27: No reversible archive state exists alongside permanent deletion.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Collections are fixed labels, not reusable saved filters with included/excluded tags.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: No personal display-settings interface or persistence exists.
